extension.summary: Search and play free movies and shorts from the BFI collection
extension.description: Showing the best from the BFI, national and regional archives - including 120 years of Britain on film.
extension.news: v1.5.5 - Film detail screen: clicking a title opens Watch Now / Watch Trailer / Add to Watchlist before playing; full metadata (plot, cast, director, country, certificate) scraped from BFI film page; trailers and watchlist require BFI+ subscription v1.5.4 - Fix autoplay: clear video playlist before resolving stream so Kodi cannot advance to next item v1.5.3 - Fix autoplay: set isFolder=False on playable items so Kodi stops queuing siblings; add aspect ratio stream hint for correct display on FireTV and other media devices v1.5.2 - Fix Collections (BS4 None-attrs bug: h3/p with class="dark" were silently skipped) v1.5.1 - Fix Collections (collection-card HTML), remove defunct Stream/Bandwidth setting, hide The Cut/BFI Replay, new menu icons v1.5.0 - UI overhaul: Subscription sub-menu (Exclusives, Recently Added, Kermode, Popular, Collections, Coming Soon), Free sub-menu (Popular, Inside Film, Shorts, Collections), Watchlist (Account) v1.4.1 - Fix subscriber video playback: correct Brightcove account (6057940601001) and MLNFA1L1R DRM player extracted from script tags v1.4.0 - BFI+ subscriber login (email/password); session cookies persisted across Kodi restarts v1.3.0 - Kodi 21 (Omega) compatibility: Python 3, Brightcove player support (replaces defunct Ooyala) v1.2.0 (21-7-19) - Updated "The Cut" to include extra videos
extension.disclaimer: >Neither this addon nor its author are in anyway affiliated with the British Film Institute
